title: path-a-regeneration-survival
purpose: Path A P5.4 golden regeneration-survival test: generate, hand-edit a real generated javaHook file, declare regenerationIntent=preserve, change the model elsewhere, regenerate -- the hand-edit survives verbatim and the model change still takes effect.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo. Driven by scripts/quality/check-golden-regeneration-survival.py.
First generate+assemble establishes 'a previous generation happened' -- P5.3's FinalAppAssembler baseline.
The generated survival-hook javaHook .java file is hand-edited (a marker line appended), standing in for a real user customization.
model.v2.json (adds a field to SurvivalRecord) is swapped in for model.json, standing in for 'the model changed elsewhere'.

Second generate+assemble (P5.3's KeepCustom outcome, driven by this fixture's own customization-provenance.json) must restore the hand-edited file verbatim while the new field shows up in the regenerated entity.
expectedOutcomes: The regenerated survival-hook .java file still contains the hand-edited marker line, byte for byte.
The regenerated SurvivalRecord entity Java file contains the new 'note' field from model.v2.json.
Neither generate+assemble call fails or blocks.
